features.title: Mark review files as viewed
features.summary: Toggle viewed state for one file in one review-session change and show the viewed progress count.
failureModes: An invalid review action URL hides the control.
A malformed or unavailable summary hides progress instead of displaying invented state.

features.title: Retain viewed marks across tabs
features.summary: Persist bounded browser-local marks, adopt cross-tab changes, and fall back safely when stored data is corrupt.
failureModes: A full retention cap evicts the oldest mark.
Corrupt storage initializes the feature empty without crashing the panel.
